args.content:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/zero3-core",
    "crates/zero3-store",
    "crates/zero3-providers",
    "crates/zero3-scheduler",
    "crates/zero3-subagents",
    "crates/zero3-memory",
    "apps/web",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/Taa965/zero3-pilot"

[workspace.dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "time", "sync"] }
async-trait = "0.1"
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "1"
